page_title: MAR 2-0 NAN | Marseille v Nantes 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
90+5' Moses Simon (Nantes) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Corner kick. Nantes will have an opportunity.
90+5' Yellow card. Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+3' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

90+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nantes, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Nantes have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' The substitution is prepared. Luis Henrique (Marseille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ismaila Sarr.

85' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
82' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to make a change. Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) replaces Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang.
82' A substitution has been made. Douglas Augusto is replaced by Kader Bamba (Nantes).
80' Jocelyn Gourvennec appears to have said too much and referee Francois Letexier comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
79' 2 - 0 Goal! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
79' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Alban Lafont makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
76' Marcus Coco (Nantes) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Good work from Nantes as they win a corner.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

71' Moses Simon (Nantes) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nantes are going to take it.
69' Moses Simon (Nantes) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
68' Marcus Coco (Nantes) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Marcus Coco (Nantes) coming on for Nicolas Cozza.
67' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Nantes have a corner.
66' Benie Traore (Nantes) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes low to the middle of the target, but Pau Lopez keeps it out.
64' Francois Letexier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille).
61' Benie Traore (Nantes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tino Kadewere.
61' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
61' Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
59' The referee signals a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Pape Gueye.
58' Here is a change. Ulisses Garcia is going off and Jean-Louis Gasset gives the last tactical orders to Quentin Merlin (Marseille).
58' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Iliman Ndiaye as he is replaced by Jean Onana (Marseille).
57' A cross into the box from Pape Gueye (Marseille) is cleared.
54' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

54' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alban Lafont makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner. The linesman makes the right call and Marseille will have a corner.
52' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) superbly wins the ball back and has a go from distance, but sends his effort high over the bar.
50' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
46' Half-time substitution. Pedro Chirivella is replaced by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Jocelyn Gourvennec probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Kelvin Amian. He is replaced by Florent Mollet (Nantes).
46' The whistle blows and Francois Letexier starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45' The resulting corner from Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes towards the roof of the net, but Pau Lopez keeps it out with an amazing save. The referee points to the corner flag and Nantes will take a corner.
43' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
43' Marseille take a short corner kick.

42' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) sends a low pass into the box, towards Amine Harit. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
38' Handball by Kelvin Amian (Nantes).
37' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
35' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pedro Chirivella (Nantes). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
35' Moses Simon (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Nantes win a corner kick.
32' Pape Gueye (Marseille) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
31' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
28' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
27' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
26' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
24' Poor challenge! Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) is penalised for tripping and Francois Letexier blows his whistle.
24' Pape Gueye (Marseille) brings an opponent down and Francois Letexier interrupts the game. Nantes are awarded the free kick.
22' Looks like Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
19' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) jumps into a tackle and Francois Letexier signals a foul.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Alban Lafont makes a huge mistake and Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
14' Amine Harit (Marseille) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
13' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is flagged for offside.
10' Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Alban Lafont comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!

9' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Douglas Augusto (Nantes). Francois Letexier saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Marseille are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
8' Amine Harit (Marseille) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
6' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Jordan Veretout (Marseille), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
6' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Marseille.

3' Close! Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
